title: PSALM 107
MIDNIGHT PRAYER
end: The Midnight Watch — stand in prayer at midnight
stock_queries: deep cosmic starry night calm deep blue
glowing candlelight in dark stone room
mountain peaks under vast night sky
calm starry ocean surface at midnight

scenes.a: If you are trapped in a dark room unable to see a way forward
Lord we bring every heavy chain and closed door into your light
Then they cried unto the LORD in their trouble and he saved them out of their distresses
He brought them out of darkness and the shadow of death and brake their bands in sunder
Oh that men would praise the LORD for his goodness and for his wonderful works to the children of men
For he hath broken the gates of brass and cut the bars of iron in sunder
